title: [main] bug 646068 - Add support for disabling incremental exchange gain/loss posting in General Ledger Setup
summary: Czech localization now allows disabling incremental exchange gain/loss posting in General Ledger Setup, letting companies choose between incremental posting and standard W1 exchange gain/loss calculations.
key_points: New setting on Currency FastTab of General Ledger Setup to toggle between incremental and W1-style exchange gain/loss posting
Defaults to disabled, preserving existing Czech incremental posting behavior without requiring data migration
When enabled, allows reversal of previously posted unrealized exchange gains and losses per W1 approach
Extended General Ledger Setup table, page, and permissions for Czech localization
Test coverage added for foreign currency scenarios
quote: When enabled, the setting allows the W1 application calculations, including the reversal of previously posted unrealized exchange gains and losses.
